answer.text: Ongoing monitoring with regular portfolio/performance review, risk tracking, and corrective engagement through fund governance

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes investor monitoring as continuing through the entire life cycle of the fund, with regular review of policies, procedures, and performance reports, oversight of portfolio composition and performance, tracking of internal and external risks, and corrective engagement through fund governance mechanisms. The Trap: Deferring monitoring to maturity, year-end only, or only when complaints arise misses the workbook's ongoing-monitoring expectation. Note: Based on workbook pages 160 and 210-214 covering ongoing monitoring, reporting templates, risk tracking, and governance.
